title: Extract the duplicated _extractFirebaseCode regex parser out of MagicLinkService and UpgradeToCloudService
rule: Fowler: duplicated code; layering tension with Rule 3
why: Both files independently reimplement 'parse a Firebase error code out of an exception's toString()' via the identical regex, because Rule 3 blocks these features/account/{domain,data} files from importing FirebaseAuthException directly and matching its typed .code field. The fallback is fragile: if a Firebase Auth SDK bump changes the exception's string format so it no longer wraps the code in literal brackets, _extractFirebaseCode silently returns null everywhere at once — in upgrade_to_cloud_service.dart this means the 'email-already-in-use' retry-merge branch falls through to rethrow, and the guided merge flow silently stops firing, surfacing a raw exception to the user instead. The same helper is also duplicated at 3 more sites repo-wide (signup_screen.dart, sign_in_controller.dart, upgrade_to_cloud_screen.dart), confirming this is a systemic gap rather than a one-off.
recommendation: Factor the regex parser into one shared, unit-tested helper (e.g. core/utils/firebase_error_code.dart, which only touches strings so it doesn't trip Rule 3) that all current call sites import.
acceptance_criteria: one shared, unit-tested extractFirebaseCode(Object e) utility exists
magic_link_service.dart and upgrade_to_cloud_service.dart delegate to it instead of each defining their own regex copy

corrections: Traced firebase_auth_gateway_impl.dart:78-87 (raw FirebaseAuthException propagates unwrapped) and upgrade_to_cloud_screen.dart:193-274 (its own duplicate of the same buggy regex also gates the EmailCollisionException catch AND the network/weak-password/invalid-email branches). All of these are dead today, not just a hypothetical future-SDK risk as the finding's 'why' frames it — this is a live, confirmed defect, so P1 not P2.

The finding frames the bug as contingent on 'if a Firebase Auth SDK bump changes the exception's string format.' I traced the actual currently-pinned dependency chain (firebase_auth 6.5.1 -> firebase_auth_platform_interface 9.0.1 -> FirebaseException.toString() in firebase_core_platform_interface 7.0.1 = '[$plugin/$code] $message') and confirmed with a live regex test that RegExp(r'\[([a-z-]+)\]') never matches '[firebase_auth/email-already-in-use] ...' because of the underscore and slash. I also traced the call chain (upgrade()->_auth.createUserAccount->AuthRepositoryImpl->FirebaseAuthGateway->raw firebase_auth SDK) and found no exception conversion anywhere, so the raw FirebaseAuthException really does reach _extractFirebaseCode. This means the described failure is not a future risk but an already-live, reachable defect today, given the SDK version actually pinned in pubspec.lock. This strengthens rather than weakens the finding.
